title: Search Funeral Zine Machine
oneLiner: A playful memorial generator that turns a dying SEO article into a direct-audience comeback asset.
targetUser: Independent publishers, niche bloggers, affiliate creators, and portfolio designers reacting to AI-search traffic collapse.
keyUx: Paste a declining URL and traffic-loss note; the machine creates a "funeral zine" with obituary headline, lost-keyword tombstones, direct-audience CTA, email signup artifact, and shareable comeback poster.
externalSignals: Signal 3: Axios report on small publishers search traffic decline - https://www.axios.com/2026/03/17/chartbeat-search-traffic-ai-chatbots
Signal 4: AI trust backlash around interview automation as a broader shareable cultural frame - https://www.hrdive.com/news/job-seekers-walk-away-from-AI-interviews/819443/
stitchPrompt: Build a playful web app prototype called "Search Funeral Zine Machine" for independent publishers whose SEO articles are losing traffic to AI search. The interface should include URL and traffic-loss input, article obituary generator, lost keyword graveyard, direct-audience conversion blocks, zine/poster preview, share/export controls, and revival checklist. Use sample data for a niche review blog whose Google referrals dropped and whose AI referrals did not compensate. Design direction: apply the `playful-experimental` profile with bold editorial collage energy, humorous memorial motifs, punchy contrast, and portfolio-worthy visual moments while keeping the conversion CTA usable.
